The city marked the 80th Anniversary of "The Great Raid" with an arts exhibit and poster-making contest organized by the Department of Education (DepEd) - Cabanatuan City, in partnership with the First Nueva Ecija N60s-POS Partnership for Development and the City Government of Cabanatuan.

Entries from the ten districts of DepEd Cabanatuan City are on display at the City Hall Lobby from January 28 to 30, 2025, showcasing creative tributes to the historic raid.

The event was attended by Atty. Myta Vergara, representing Mayor Myca Vergara, along with educators,, and local officials. This initiative highlights the city’s ongoing efforts to preserve its history and inspire younger generations.
